title: nightmill project configuration (.claude/nightmill.json)
description: Everything the nightmill skills and scripts need to know about one project. Unknown keys are ignored.

owner.description: GitHub user or organisation that owns the repository and the project board.

projectNumber.description: Number of the GitHub Projects (v2) board, as in `gh project view N`.

name.description: How the skills address the person who sets Ready and Approved.

board.description: Field and option names on the board. The flow itself is fixed: backlog > ready > spec > specReview > approved > inProgress > review > done.

areas.description: Area options for the issue forms and the board's Area field.

invariants.description: Project rules every story and bug must respect. Rendered as a checkbox list into the issue forms.

check.description: The local equivalent of CI: one command run from the repository root, non-zero exit on failure.

manualCheckPaths.description: A change under one of these paths also needs the manual check.

manualCheckText.description: What the manual check is, in one sentence.

benchRule.description: Optional extra testing rule, for example which code needs a benchmark.

storyTriggers.description: Kinds of change that turn a bug into a story and block auto-merge, for example a new rule, tuning numbers, a wire-format change.

maxAgents.description: Agents (subagents, slot builds) running at the same time on this machine. Rule of thumb: one per 8 GB of RAM.

hotFiles.description: Files or directories only one task may touch at a time.

doNotPair.description: Kinds of tasks that must not run side by side, for example two benchmark-heavy tasks.

root.description: Where slot worktrees live, relative to the main checkout. Default: ../<checkout-folder>-wt

slots.description: Number of permanent slots. WORKER_SLOTS in the environment overrides it.

ports.description: Port bases by name; slot N gets base + N. Example: {"server": 8100, "client": 5200}.

dir.description: Directory inside the worktree to run in. Default: the worktree root.

lockfile.description: Relative to the worktree. When set, the command runs only when this file's hash changed since the last run in that slot.

warmup.description: Commands that make a slot ready to build, for example npm ci.

runHints.description: Lines printed after a slot is taken. {slot} and {port.<name>} are replaced.
